questions.stem: Which of the following sodium-dependent phosphate cotransporters located in the renal proximal tubule apical membrane is strictly electroneutral, carrying 2 sodium ions for each divalent phosphate molecule?
questions.sourceExplanation: NaPi-SLC34A3 屬於 100% Electroneutral cotransporter，運送 2 個 Na+ 與 1 個 H2PO4-。相反地，NaPi-SLC34A1 屬於 Electrogenic cotransporter，運送 3 個 Na+ 與 1 個 H2PO4-。NaPi-HHRH。

questions.stem: A 7-year-old boy presents with severe rickets, lower extremity bowing, and mark hypercalciuria with recurrent nephrolithiasis. Laboratory evaluation reveals low serum phosphate, normal serum calcium, suppressed serum intact FGF23, and markedly elevated serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D. Which of the following genetic mutations is most likely responsible for his condition?
questions.sourceExplanation: HHRH，其致病基因為 SLC34A3 (編碼 NaPi-IIc)。由於非 FGF23 媒介的失磷導致血磷低下，進而解除對 CYP27B1 (1-α-hydroxylase) 的抑制，使 1,OH2D 顯著上升。高濃度的 1,OH2D 促進Intestinal大量吸收鈣質，引起Hypercalciuria 與Nephrolithiasis。

questions.stem: Regarding the administration of active vitamin D (Calcitriol) in patients with Hereditary Hypophosphatemic Rickets with Hypercalciuria (HHRH), which of the following statements represents the standard clinical management guideline?

options.text: Calcitriol is the cornerstone of therapy and should be co-administered with oral phosphate to heal rickets.
Calcitriol should be given only if serum intact FGF23 levels exceed 100 pg/mL.
Calcitriol is strictly contraindicated because it exacerbates hypercalciuria and accelerates nephrocalcinosis.
Calcitriol should be combined with Burosumab to achieve optimal renal phosphate reabsorption.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 HHRH 患者中，Strictly Contraindicated！因為 HHRH 患者體內的 1,OH2D 原本就因Hypophosphatemia刺激 CYP27B1 而處於高檔，若再給予外源性 Calcitriol，會劇烈惡化Intestinal鈣吸收，導致極度嚴重的Hypercalciuria、Nephrolithiasis與Nephrocalcinosis，最終破壞Renal Function。HHRH 僅需使用 Oral Soluble Phosphate 治療即可。

questions.stem: Which of the following molecular mechanisms explains why loss-of-function mutations in PHEX cause X-linked hypophosphatemia (XLH)?

options.text: PHEX directly cleaves and inactivates circulating intact FGF23 in the renal proximal tubule.
PHEX mutation prevents the O-glycosylation of FGF23 by GALNT3, accelerating Furin cleavage.
PHEX acts as an apical sodium-phosphate cotransporter that undergoes degradation when mutated.
Mutant PHEX in osteocytes leads to uninhibited expression and impaired degradation of intact FGF23 via downstream signaling pathways.

questions.sourceExplanation: PHEX 屬於表達於 Osteocytes 與 Osteoblasts 的 Endopeptidase。雖然過去曾以為 PHEX 直接切割 FGF23，但最新研究證實 PHEX 並不直接胜肽切割 Intact FGF23；變異的 PHEX 會經由Osteocytes內轉錄調節與細胞外基質訊息傳遞失調，導致 Intact FGF23 轉錄與分泌過量且降解受阻，引發全身性高 FGF23 症候群。

questions.stem: A 28-year-old woman with a history of normal childhood development presents with recent-onset bone pain, muscle weakness, and pseudofractures. Lab testing demonstrates hypophosphatemic osteomalacia with elevated serum intact FGF23. Genetic sequencing confirms a heterozygous R176Q mutation in the FGF23 gene. Which of the following systemic conditions is most recognized as an environmental trigger for disease manifestations in this disorder?
questions.sourceExplanation: ADHR，由 FGF23 基因 R176Q 或 R179Q 突變引發（破壞 Furin 切割位點 RXXR）。ADHR 具不完全顯性且發病年齡跨度大。Iron Deficiency 會刺激Osteocytes轉錄 FGF23；在正常人中增加的 FGF23 會被 Furin 切割降解，但在 ADHR 患者中由於變異 FGF23 抗拒 Furin 切割，導致完整的 Intact FGF23 暴增而引發成人期發病。

questions.stem: Which of the following clinical features distinguishes Dent disease 1 (caused by CLCN5 mutations) from X-linked hypophosphatemia (XLH)?

options.text: Elevated serum intact FGF23 levels causing renal phosphate wasting
Presence of low-molecular-weight proteinuria (such as beta-2 microglobulin) and marked hypercalciuria

questions.stem: Burosumab is an FDA-approved therapeutic agent for X-linked hypophosphatemia (XLH). What is the precise pharmacological mechanism of action of Burosumab?

options.text: Recombinant PTH receptor antagonist that prevents PTH-mediated endocytosis of NaPi-IIa.
Small molecule agonist of the extracellular calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR).
Recombinant human IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds to and neutralizes intact FGF23.
Selective inhibitor of renal 24-hydroxylase (CYP24A1) enzyme activity.

questions.sourceExplanation: Burosumab 是一種全人類源化 IgG1 Human Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody，可特異性結合並中和過量的 Intact FGF23，進而解除其對Proximal Tubule NaPi-IIa / NaPi-IIc 以及 CYP27B1 (1-α-hydroxylase) 的抑制，恢復血磷與 1,OH2D 濃度，促進Rickets與Osteomalacia的癒合。

questions.stem: In the renal proximal tubule, which scaffolding protein physically anchors NaPi-IIa to the actin cytoskeleton via PDZ domain interactions, and whose loss-of-function mutation causes autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic nephrolithiasis?

questions.stem: A 16-year-old adolescent boy presents with severe subcutaneous, periarticular calcified masses around his elbows and hips. Laboratory evaluation reveals hyperphosphatemia (serum phosphate 8.2 mg/dL), normal serum calcium, elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, and markedly suppressed intact FGF23 levels. Genetic testing demonstrates a homozygous loss-of-function mutation in GALNT3. What is the diagnosis?
questions.sourceExplanation: HFTC。GALNT3 編碼 UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine:polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 3，負責將 Intact FGF23 的 Thr178 進行 O-Glycosylation，防止其被 Furin 切割。GALNT3 突變導致 Intact FGF23 無法被糖基化保護而被快速切割破壞，引發功能性 FGF23 缺乏、Proximal TubuleHyperphosphatemia 及 1,OH2D 升高，導致關節周圍Tumoral Calcinosis。

questions.stem: In patients with X-linked hypophosphatemia (XLH) receiving conventional therapy with oral soluble phosphate and calcitriol, which of the following parameters must be routinely monitored to prevent severe treatment-related complications?

options.text: Urinary uric acid excretion for gouty nephropathy
Serum aluminum levels for osteomalacia toxicity
Urinary calcium-to-creatinine ratio and renal ultrasonography for nephrocalcinosis
Serum calcitonin levels for medullary thyroid cancer

questions.sourceExplanation: XLH 的傳統治療為口服補充 Soluble Phosphate 加上 Calcitriol。補充口服磷會引起暫時性血鈣降低並刺激 PTH 產生 Secondary/Tertiary Hyperparathyroidism；而 Calcitriol 會增加Intestinal鈣吸收，當兩者劑量過高或不平衡時，極易引發Hypercalciuria 與Nephrocalcinosis。因此必須定期監測 Urinary Calcium/Creatinine ratio 與 Renal Ultrasonography。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements correctly describes the effect of Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) on proximal tubular phosphate reabsorption?

options.text: PTH inhibits CYP27B1 (1-alpha-hydroxylase), thereby suppressing intestinal phosphate absorption.
PTH directly upregulates NHERF1 expression to stabilize NaPi-IIa on the apical brush border membrane.
PTH binds to basolateral PTHR1, activating PKA and PKC pathways to induce endocytosis and lysosomal degradation of apical NaPi-IIa and NaPi-IIc cotransporters.
PTH increases maximum tubular reabsorption of phosphate per glomerular filtration rate (TmP/GFR).

questions.sourceExplanation: PTH 結合至Proximal TubuleBasolateral Membrane的 PTHR1 受體後，同時啟動 Gs-PKA 與 Gq-PKC 訊息傳導路徑，促使 NHERF1 磷酸化並與 NaPi-IIa / NaPi-IIc 解離。Apical Membrane上的 NaPiCotransporters 迅速經由 Clathrin-coated pits 發生Endocytosis 並在 Lysosome 內進行降解，導致 TmP/GFR 降低與尿磷排泄增加。
